events.name: Event planning
events.objective: Lift the weight of organising off your family.
events.title: Your event, without the load.
events.body: From birthdays to large family gatherings, we take on the design, the suppliers, the schedule and the day itself. You stay the host; we carry everything else.

detail.photoAlt: Two decorators setting up a wedding reception: ivory drapery and a floral centrepiece.

includes.1: The design of the event: theme, colour palette, floor plan
includes.2: Finding and booking the venue, including the visit
includes.3: Full decoration: drapery, flowers, lighting, table settings
includes.4: Renting or buying the equipment: chairs, marquees, tableware, sound
includes.5: Choosing and coordinating suppliers: caterer, baker, photographer, music
includes.6: Waiting staff and hosts on the day, on request
includes.7: A preparation schedule and budget tracking
includes.8: Coordination on the day, then teardown and handing the venue back

1.title: We listen
1.body: A first conversation to understand the occasion, the number of guests, your wishes and your budget.

2.title: We propose
2.body: A concept, a venue, a decoration plan and a detailed quote, within 48 hours.

3.title: We prepare
3.body: Suppliers, equipment, schedule: everything booked, checked and confirmed before the date.

4.title: You host
4.body: On the day our team sets up, coordinates and takes down. You stay the host, nothing more.

detail.note: Already have a venue or a caterer? We fit around them and take on only what you are missing.

coaching.name: Teen coaching
coaching.objective: Help your teenager through the adolescent crisis and build a better future.
coaching.title: Through adolescence, and stronger for it.
coaching.body: Patient, structured, confidential support: confidence, direction, family relationships, study method. We work with the teenager, and with the parents.

detail.photoAlt: A bright room set up for a teenagers' group: a circle of chairs, notebooks and a flip chart.

types.2: School choices and plans for the future
types.4: Family relationships and talking at home
types.6: Social life, peer pressure and screen time

includes.1: A first conversation to set the frame, with the parents and the teenager
includes.2: Regular one-to-one sessions, in full confidence
includes.3: Sessions with the parents, so everyone pulls the same way
includes.4: Retreats and camps during the holidays
includes.5: Wellbeing spaces: somewhere to meet, learn and socialise while having fun
includes.6: Group workshops: speaking up, managing time, a personal project
includes.7: A progress review with the parents at the end of each cycle

1.title: First contact
1.body: You tell us what worries you. We agree on a first conversation, with no commitment.

2.title: We set the frame
2.body: Goals, how often you meet and the rules of confidentiality, agreed by the teenager and the parents alike.

3.title: We walk alongside
3.body: Regular sessions, concrete exercises between them, and camps if they want to go.

4.title: We take stock
4.body: At the end of each cycle, a review with the family: what has moved, what is still to build.

detail.note: What a teenager tells us stays confidential. We share progress with parents, never confidences.

home.name: Housekeeping and decoration
home.objective: Create beauty and calm in your homes and your offices.
home.title: A clean home, a quiet mind.
home.body: A regular visit, a consistent team, a standard that doesn't move. And if you'd like it, a decorator's eye — so the space isn't only clean, but beautiful.

detail.photoAlt: A housekeeper finishing a decorated living room: aligned cushions, cream throw, fresh eucalyptus.

types.1: Living room, dining room and offices
types.5: Floors, interior windows and high dusting
types.6: Tidying, ironing and taking out the bins

includes.1: A free first visit to assess the space and agree the detail
includes.2: A consistent, trained team, introduced to you: the same faces every visit
includes.3: Products and equipment provided, suited to your surfaces
includes.4: A rhythm you choose: once, weekly, fortnightly or monthly
includes.5: Putting a space back in order after works, a move or a reception
includes.6: A checklist verified at every visit, so the standard doesn't move
includes.7: A decorator's eye as an option: colours, furniture and accessories
includes.8: Making a space beautiful before an event or before guests arrive

1.title: We come and look
1.body: A visit to measure the space, understand your standards and agree the rhythm.

2.title: We propose
2.body: A clear quote: what is done, how often, by how many people and for how much.

3.title: We take over
3.body: The same team, on the agreed days, with a checklist verified at every visit.

4.title: We adjust
4.body: A review after the first month, then whenever you ask. The standard fits your home.

detail.note: Decoration can come on its own: advice, selection and installation, with no cleaning contract.

property.name: Property management
property.short: Airbnb, apartments, property at a distance
property.objective: Let you collect your rent without the hassle.
property.title: Your property, in good hands.
property.body: For owners far from their property, or simply too busy: welcoming tenants, upkeep, small repairs, rent tracking and a regular report. You collect; we keep watch.

detail.photoAlt: A property manager handing the keys of a bright furnished apartment to a young couple.

types.1: Apartments and houses on long-term lets
types.5: Empty property to watch over and maintain

includes.1: Presenting the property: photos, listing and publication
includes.2: Finding and vetting tenants, guarantees checked
includes.3: Inventories on arrival and departure, with photographs
includes.4: Welcoming tenants and handing over the keys
includes.5: Rent tracking and reminders, then payment into your account
includes.6: Everyday upkeep and small repairs, quoted before any spending
includes.7: Short-stay turnover: cleaning, linen and welcome between guests
includes.8: A monthly report: money in, money out, anything that happened

1.title: We visit the property
1.body: We assess its condition, what it can earn and how much watching it needs.

2.title: We agree the mandate
2.body: Services chosen, a spending ceiling and our fees: all in writing before we start.

3.title: We manage
3.body: Tenants, rent, upkeep, emergencies: you have one number to call, ours.

4.title: You collect
4.body: Every month, your rent and a clear report, with no unexpected spending.

detail.note: Above the agreed ceiling, no repair goes ahead without your written approval.

sourcing.name: Purchase facilitation
sourcing.objective: Let you do your shopping in comfort.
sourcing.title: What you need, found and delivered.
sourcing.body: Online or in local markets, we search, compare, negotiate and deliver. Tell us what you're looking for and we'll come back with a clear proposal.

detail.photoAlt: A buyer comparing fabric at the market, list in hand and baskets filled.

types.6: Materials and tools for your works

includes.1: A search online and in local markets, from your list
includes.2: An honest comparison: price, quality, delay, and our reservations if we have any
includes.3: Negotiating with the sellers, in your place
includes.4: Checking every item before it is paid for
includes.5: Transport and delivery to your door, at the agreed time
includes.7: Recurring purchases on a fixed date, for companies
includes.8: The receipts for everything, handed over with the order

1.title: You tell us
1.body: Your list, your preferences and your budget. A photo or a link is often enough.

2.title: We search
2.body: Online and on the ground. We come back within 48 hours with costed options.

3.title: You choose
3.body: You approve an option. We buy, check and gather the order together.

4.title: We deliver
4.body: Delivered to your door with the receipts, and installed if you'd like.

detail.note: No hidden commission on your purchases: our fee is stated in the quote.

hero.title: Who are we?
hero.intro: Facility is your everyday partner in Bujumbura, for families, homes and businesses. We organise your events, from weddings and dowry ceremonies to birthdays and retreats, and we take on what weighs on your days: decorating and cleaning your spaces, managing your rental properties, doing your shopping. We also create spaces and stays where teenagers learn about themselves and grow. One point of contact, one standard, and one goal: to make your life lighter.

hero.vision: We create comfort, wellbeing and joy — in the family and everywhere else.

founder.photoAlt: Portrait of Dusenge Kathia Daslim, CEO of Facility.
founder.quote: Entrusting us with part of your everyday life is an act of trust. We look after it as if it were our own.
founder.story1: Facility was born from something I saw far too often around me: in every family, one person carries everything. The celebration to organise, the home to keep, a property to rent out from afar, a teenager searching for their place — and almost no time left for themselves.
founder.story2: I wanted those people to finally have someone they could count on: a single partner, reliable and caring, who takes things in hand with the same care as someone close to them. That is how Facility was born, here in Bujumbura.
founder.story3: Today, every request is followed personally and every commitment is kept. You tell us what is weighing on you; we take care of it. And our finest reward is still that “wow” on your face.
